finding.functional_result: The fresh packaged UI run reached the actual 8-document FlowRun in Completed/Released state, rendered the native progress card and followed the TaskRun link.
finding.failed_observation: The original probe recorded one late pageerror, Cannot read properties of null (reading x), after its former empty-error assertion point. That run is not a zero-page-error PASS.
finding.replay_result: Twenty-four bounded read-only replays of the same completed state observed zero page errors, including timeline runs that waited two animation frames plus 500ms and closed the context.
finding.classification: The observation is unresolved and non-reproduced. It neither proves a native backend/protocol failure nor permits a clean-UI claim. No baseline, teardown or product root cause is asserted.

decision: A scoped bounded-foundation acceptance is permitted after a corrected, source-bound UI successor satisfies every condition below. The retained single failure does not require a speculative runtime change when the improved probe and repeated controls remain clean; recurrence under the corrected probe is a blocker.
mandatory_successor_conditions: Preserve the original failed live log/result unchanged and archive it as a negative finding.
Keep pageerror collection active through settled frames, context close and browser close; write the final report and assert the final error list only after those lifecycle points.
Capture error message, phase, elapsed time, URL and stack when the browser supplies them; do not invent a missing stack.
Run a negative control that injects a late pageerror after the former assertion point and prove that the corrected probe reports a nonzero error and fails.

Run at least one fresh packaged actual PostgreSQL/ProcessWorker 8-document flow with the corrected probe and current served bundle; require Completed/Released state, progress card, TaskRun navigation and zero final page errors.
Retain the 24 clean read-only replays as bounded adjunct evidence; do not substitute them for the fresh end-to-end successor.
Repeat the full UI unit gate, browser gate, typecheck, lint, format, build and exact served-asset byte comparison on the successor source.
Record an explicit source-relevance bridge showing backend/Python/runtime bytes unchanged and the probe-only path delta.
Require hosted CI and CodeQL to pass on the final committed source before closing 100%.

failure_policy.if_pageerror_recurs: Block final acceptance and investigate the actual stack/timeline before changing product code or classifying the cause.
failure_policy.if_negative_control_is_not_detected: Reject the probe as incapable of supporting a zero-error claim.
failure_policy.if_successor_is_clean: Accept the UI portion scoped to the bounded profile while retaining the original intermittent observation as a disclosed limitation.

source_reuse: The prior 25-profile Python/backend evidence may remain source-relevant only if the successor bridge proves those bytes, selections, configuration and dependencies unchanged. The UI successor must be rerun because the acceptance probe changes.
scope_after_success: PASS_SCOPED may cover the bounded native foundation only: finite linear graph, trusted same-host Linux/PID namespace and declared resource limits. It does not add HA, cross-host recovery, arbitrary DAG, performance SLO or a new 72-hour native claim.
conditions_remaining: corrected probe source and negative control
